Key Observations

  • 8 bird species detected acoustically over the survey period (04 Aug 2026 20:45 to 05 Aug 2026 11:09).
  • Acoustic data indicates use of two habitat layers within the survey area.
  • Dawn chorus activity (04:00–08:00) was strong (100.0% biological sound).
  • Human-associated noise was low during the recording period (2.5% of survey).
  • Species of conservation interest: None identified during survey period.

ⓘ This report presents data from an automated acoustic pilot survey. It is intended as indicative supplementary evidence only and does not constitute a formal ecological survey or assessment. All species identifications are model outputs and should be verified by a qualified ecologist before use in any planning, statutory, or formal reporting context.

Ambient & Background Sound Log

The acoustic classifier detected the following interference classes during the survey. Files containing noise events may have reduced detection sensitivity - this should be considered when interpreting survey completeness and species absence.

TypeClips detectedFiles affectedImplication
🐕 Dog 4 clips 1 / 73 files (1%) Dog vocalisations detected - may mask or interfere with bird call detection.
💨 Movement 5 clips 2 / 73 files (3%) Physical movement artefacts detected - handling noise or equipment vibration.
🧍 People 2 clips 1 / 73 files (1%) Human voices or crowd noise detected - may mask or be mistaken for bird calls.
✈️ Plane 49 clips 12 / 73 files (16%) Aircraft noise creates broadband interference, potentially causing missed detections.
🌧 Rain 49 clips 15 / 73 files (21%) Rain interference masks bird calls and degrades spectrogram quality.
👤 User 7 clips 1 / 73 files (1%) Human noise detected - may indicate disturbance or handling artefacts.
🌬 Wind 70 clips 22 / 73 files (30%) High wind noise reduces detection sensitivity across all frequency bands.

ⓘ 186 total ambient noise clips detected across 54 file occurrences (74% of survey files affected).

Interpretation Note

Site exhibits compromised acoustic integrity requiring immediate mitigation, with low-level recreational activity within acceptable parameters.
